relations.text: フラッシュメモリーはすべてKioxiaとの合弁事業から調達(ウエハーの供給)
relations.text_en: All of its flash memory comes from the joint ventures with Kioxia, which supply the wafers

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: All of our flash-based memory is obtained from our joint ventures with Kioxia, which provide us with leading-edge, high-quality flash memory wafers.

relations.text: 四日市工場の合弁契約をさらに5年延長(2034年まで、2026年1月)
relations.text_en: Extended the Yokkaichi joint venture agreements by five years, through 2034 (January 2026)

source.label: Sandisk/Kioxia joint の発表
source.quote: extension of their joint venture agreements at Kioxia's Yokkaichi Plant for an additional five years

relations.text: 3つの合弁事業(Flash Ventures)で、日本の8つのフラッシュ製造施設を運営
relations.text_en: Operates three ventures (Flash Ventures) across eight flash manufacturing facilities in Japan

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We and Kioxia currently operate three business ventures, Flash Partners Ltd., Flash Alliance Ltd. and Flash Forward Ltd., (collectively, "Flash Ventures")

relations.text: Sandiskが年次報告で、競合する垂直統合型のフラッシュメーカーとしてKioxiaを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sandisk’s annual report names Kioxia among the vertically integrated flash suppliers it competes with

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We compete with vertically-integrated suppliers such as Kioxia, Micron Technology, Inc., Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SK Hynix, Inc.

relations.text: SandiskにDRAMを供給する複数年の戦略的な供給契約(2026年3月)
relations.text_en: Multi-year strategic arrangement to supply Sandisk with DRAM products (March 2026)

source.label: Sandisk 8-K(2026-03-25)
source.quote: Nanya will supply the Company with DRAM products.

relations.text: Sandiskの子会社がNanyaの株式約1.39億株(約10億ドル、完全希薄化後で約3.9%)を取得する契約
relations.text_en: A Sandisk subsidiary agreed to buy about 139 million Nanya shares for about $1.0B (about 3.9% fully diluted)

source.label: Sandisk 8-K(2026-03-25)
source.quote: agreed to purchase approximately 139 million shares of Nanya common stock for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1.0 billion
source.note: 取得後の届出と3年間の売却制限が条件です。
source.note_en: Subject to post-closing filings and a three-year statutory lock-up.

relations.text: 2025年2月21日に分離が完了するまで、Western Digitalの完全子会社だった
relations.text_en: Wholly owned by Western Digital until the separation completed on February 21, 2025

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Prior to February 21, 2025, we were wholly owned by Western Digital Corporation

relations.text: 分離時に、Western DigitalがSandisk株2,880万株を保有
relations.text_en: At the separation, Western Digital initially retained 28.8 million Sandisk shares

source.label: Western Digital 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: As part of the Separation, we initially retained 28.8 million shares of Sandisk common stock.
source.note: その後、Western Digitalは株式の一部を現金化しています。
source.note_en: Western Digital later monetized shares; the current holding is not stated here.

relations.text: 組み立て・テスト合弁のSDSSは、Sandisk 20%・JCETの子会社80%の持分
relations.text_en: The SDSS assembly and test venture is owned 20% by Sandisk and 80% by a JCET subsidiary

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: a venture that is owned 20% by Sandisk and 80% by JCET Management Co., Ltd.

relations.text: SanDisk ChinaがSDSS持分の80%をJCETへ売却(2024年9月28日完了)
relations.text_en: SanDisk China sold 80% of its equity interest in SDSS to JCET (closed September 28, 2024)

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: The Transaction closed on September 28, 2024, and SanDisk China completed the sale of 80 % of its equity interest in SDSS to JCET.

relations.text: 高帯域フラッシュ(HBF)の仕様づくりで覚書(MOU)を締結(2025年8月)
relations.text_en: MOU to establish the specification for High Bandwidth Flash (August 2025)

source.label: Sandisk の発表
source.quote: signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with SK hynix to work together to establish the specification for High Bandwidth Flash
source.note: 覚書の段階で、仕様の標準化は「見込み」とされています。
source.note_en: MOU stage; standardization is described as expected.

relations.text: Sandiskが年次報告で、競合する垂直統合型のフラッシュメーカーとしてSK hynixを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sandisk’s annual report names SK hynix among the vertically integrated flash suppliers it competes with

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We compete with vertically-integrated suppliers such as Kioxia, Micron Technology, Inc., Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SK Hynix, Inc.

relations.text: Sandiskが年次報告で、競合する垂直統合型のフラッシュメーカーとしてMicronを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sandisk’s annual report names Micron among its vertically integrated flash competitors

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We compete with vertically-integrated suppliers such as Kioxia, Micron Technology, Inc., Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SK Hynix, Inc.

relations.text: Micronが年次報告で、競合としてSandiskを挙げている
relations.text_en: Micron’s annual report lists Sandisk among its memory and storage competitors

source.label: Micron 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.; SK hynix Inc.; Kioxia Holdings Corporation; Sandisk Corporation;

relations.text: Sandiskが年次報告で、競合する垂直統合型のフラッシュメーカーとしてSamsung Electronicsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sandisk’s annual report names Samsung Electronics among the vertically integrated flash suppliers it competes with

source.label: Sandisk 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We compete with vertically-integrated suppliers such as Kioxia, Micron Technology, Inc., Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SK Hynix, Inc.
